how.title: Four steps from forgotten archive to a new beginning.

s1.title: Upload
s1.text: Add a PDF report, Markdown notes or a code folder tree, after your team agrees.

s2.title: Verify
s2.text: AI drafts the unfinished tasks. You keep, edit or remove each one before anything is public.

s3.title: Continue
s3.text: A team reads the teaser, then takes access right away or sends a short plan, as the owners chose.

s4.title: Continue with credit
s4.text: Each person who continues accepts the attribution agreement. Private files open and the lineage is logged.

g1.title: Every task cites its source
g1.text: Each drafted task links to a page or file, and ESTAFET checks that the quoted text really exists there.

g2.title: Nothing public until verified
g2.text: Publishing stays blocked until the owners have reviewed every drafted item.

g3.title: Advisor consent first
g3.text: Advisors approve through a private link before a project can be published, or the owners declare that there is no advisor.

terms.draft: Draft, not yet reviewed by the university. This is version 1 of the Terms. A full text will replace it before launch.
terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: ESTAFET helps student teams hand over discontinued competition and research projects to the next team.
terms.l1: You may share a project only if you worked on it and you have the right to share it. Everyone on the team must agree.
terms.l2: The public teaser shows only what you approve. Your files stay private and open only to people who hold access.
terms.l3: Anyone who takes access accepts the attribution agreement and credits the original team.
terms.l4: Anyone can report a project. The ESTAFET team may hold, hide or remove a project, with a written reason you can appeal.
terms.l5: Do not upload secrets, personal data of other people, or files you may not share.
terms.note: The attribution agreement is a simple template for student projects. It is not legal advice.

privacy.draft: Draft, not yet reviewed by the university. This is version 1 of the Privacy Policy. A full text will replace it before launch.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: What ESTAFET stores and does today:
privacy.l1: Your account: name, email address, and the faculty you choose to give. We record which version of these documents you accepted.
privacy.l2: Your projects: the details you enter, and the files you upload. Files are stored privately and are not shown on public pages.
privacy.l3: AI drafting: when you ask for a draft, the text of your files is sent to the AI provider that ESTAFET is configured to use. In demo mode a built-in simulator is used and nothing leaves the server. Every team member must agree before this happens.
privacy.l4: Reports and moderation: a report is stored with its reason. The owner of a project never sees who reported it.
privacy.l5: Security: we keep a hashed form of an address to limit abuse. We do not store file contents in logs.
privacy.note: Rights to access, correct, export and delete your data are described in the full text. Data export and account deletion are not built yet.
